about.metaDescription: Learn more about Wadi Degla – our history, mission, and global presence in the natural stone industry.
about.introText1: At Wadi Degla Marble & Granite, three generations of passion and expertise converge to bring you the finest natural stone products. We are delighted to introduce you to our legacy, our values, and our commitment to excellence in every project we undertake.
about.introText2: Our family-owned business has been a cornerstone in the marble and granite industry for over four decades, and we invite you to discover how our heritage and innovation can contribute to the success of your next grand vision.
about.expertiseIntro: At Wadi Degla Marble & Granite, we specialize in supplying high-quality marble and granite for large-scale construction projects, including hotels, resorts, compounds, and commercial developments. We are the trusted partner for large marble and granite companies worldwide, capable of managing projects of any scale.
about.globalReachText: We have successfully executed monumental projects and export to America, Europe, Africa, and other regions. With our branch in Gambia and the upcoming Cleopatra by Wadi Degla in South America, we are strategically positioned to serve clients worldwide.
about.resourcesText: With multiple factories under our name and partnerships with numerous others, we have the capacity to meet the most demanding requirements.
about.graniteText: We are partners in a multitude of granite factories, enabling us to provide a diverse range of products and be ready for any project.
about.partnershipsText: Our collaborations extend to quarries in Italy and Turkey, enhancing our product offerings with premium international stones.
about.solutionsText: Our team works closely with clients to tailor our offerings to their unique specifications, timelines, and budgets—delivering solutions that surpass expectations.
about.thanksTitle: Elevate Your Vision with Wadi Degla
about.thanksText: Wadi Degla Marble & Granite is synonymous with grandeur, quality, and a relentless pursuit of perfection. Our commitment to excellence is unrivaled, and our legacy is built on delivering unmatched value to our clients. When you choose Wadi Degla, you're not just selecting a supplier you're partnering with a family dedicated to turning your architectural dreams into timeless realities.

cobbles.metaDescription: Explore our wide range of premium cobbles and paving solutions. Discover flamed, tumbled, and natural finish granite cobbles for your outdoor spaces.
cobbles.graniteText1: Our granite cobbles represent the perfect blend of durability and aesthetic appeal. Each piece is carefully crafted to meet the highest standards of quality and design, ensuring longevity and visual impact in every application.
cobbles.graniteText2: We offer a diverse range of finishes and sizes, allowing for creative flexibility in both residential and commercial projects. From traditional cobblestone streets to modern urban landscapes, our granite cobbles provide the ideal foundation for timeless outdoor spaces.
cobbles.graniteText3: The natural beauty of granite, combined with our expert craftsmanship, results in cobbles that not only enhance the visual appeal of any space but also stand the test of time, weather, and wear.
cobbles.flamedPavingText1: Flamed paving is a testament to modern stone processing technology, where granite surfaces are subjected to intense heat, causing the crystal structure to burst and create a naturally textured, slip-resistant surface. This innovative treatment method results in a unique finish that combines safety with sophisticated aesthetics.
cobbles.flamedPavingText2: The process creates micro-fissures on the surface of the granite, giving it an attractive, naturally weathered appearance while maintaining the stone's inherent strength and durability. This textured surface not only enhances the visual appeal but also provides excellent traction in both wet and dry conditions.
cobbles.flamedPavingText3: The color of the granite becomes more pronounced after the flaming process, revealing subtle variations and natural patterns within the stone. This enhanced appearance adds depth and character to outdoor spaces, making each installation unique and visually striking.
cobbles.flamedPavingText4: Furthermore, flamed paving is renowned for its durability and resilience. The process of subjecting the stone to high temperatures makes it less prone to weathering and erosion. This means that flamed paving not only maintains its visual appeal over time but also stands up to the rigors of changing weather patterns, heavy foot traffic, and vehicular loads.
cobbles.flamedPavingText5: Maintenance-wise, flamed paving is relatively low-maintenance. Its textured surface helps camouflage dirt and stains, requiring less frequent cleaning compared to smoother surfaces. Regular sweeping and occasional power washing are usually sufficient to keep the paving looking pristine.
cobbles.flamedPavingText6: In conclusion, flamed paving is a versatile and functional choice for outdoor spaces. By marrying aesthetic appeal with practical advantages such as slip resistance and durability, it transforms landscapes into both visually captivating and functional areas. Whether enhancing the charm of a residential backyard or adding a touch of elegance to a commercial outdoor space, flamed paving is a testament to the synergy between nature's raw beauty and human ingenuity.

exports.departmentText: Our export department serves as the vital gateway to global markets, facilitating the distribution of exquisite natural stone products to discerning clientele around the world. Our department is responsible for orchestrating a seamless flow of operations, from negotiating international contracts and coordinating logistics to ensuring compliance with customs regulations and quality standards. With a keen eye for market trends and a deep understanding of diverse customer preferences, our export team identifies strategic opportunities for expanding the factory's reach. Moreover, we forge valuable relationships with international partners, architects, and designers, creating a network that not only promotes the brand but also fosters innovation and collaboration. Through our expertise and tireless dedication, the export department plays a pivotal role in showcasing the factory's craftsmanship and enhancing its global reputation as a premier supplier of premium natural stone products.

packing.metaDescription: Learn about Wadi Degla's marble and granite packing methods, including slabs and tiles packaging for safe global delivery.
packing.woodenBundleText: The slabs are gathered in groups each group contains from 8 to 15 slabs according to their thickness packed in wooden bundles & loaded either in 20 feet box container using the boom crane or in open container using the overhead crane according to the request of our customer as well as the availability of the open top containers. N.B. Polished Slabs are separated by plastic sheets to be protected against scratches.
packing.normalPackingTitle: Slabs Normal Packing From Wadi Degla
packing.normalPackingText: The slabs are manually placed directly on the ground of the container lashed on two wooden bars (coverlets) on the inner long sides of 20 feet dry box container. If the slabs are long in length, the container takes only two groups, one to the right and the other to the left. If the slabs are short in length, the container takes four groups of slabs, two to the right and two to the left. N.B. Polished Slabs are separated by plastic sheets to be protected against scratches.
packing.woodenCratesText: Tiles are packed after being highly selected according to the approved samples in wooden crates (boxes) lined by foam for better protection. Each wooden crate contains a certain number of tiles according to the thickness. All the crate content details are mentioned in the label paper fixed on the outside of the crate. Only 12"x12" tiles (10mm +/- 0.5 thick) are packed in Styrofoam boxes before being packed inside the wooden crates. Thin plastic sheets are added between polished faces of the tiles to avoid surface scratching.
packing.woodenPalletText: Tiles are packed after being highly selected according to the approved samples on wooden pallets surrounded by foam for better protection, and fastened with plastic belts with rubber pieces on the edges to avoid any damages that might happen. According to the size & thickness of the tiles, each wooden pallet contains a certain number of tiles. All details of the pallet contents are mentioned in the label paper fixed on the lateral side of the pallet.

history.metaDescription: Discover the legacy and milestones of the Alghanam family and Wadi Degla in Egypt's marble and granite industry.
history.firstGenIntro: Since 1951, Alghanam family has been synonymous with innovation and leadership in Egypt’s marble and granite quarrying industry. Our story is rooted in determination, ambition, and a deep respect for the natural resources that define our country’s rich geological heritage. Over the decades, many prominent members of the Alghanam family have secured and safeguarded the quarrying industry in Egypt—because it truly runs in our veins.
history.visionaryBeginningsText: The true turning point in our family’s journey came in 1980 with the ambition of our founder, Alhag Saed Alghanam. Determined to master the art and science of quarrying, he immersed himself in the craft, learning everything from extraction techniques to material quality. His curiosity led him to the iconic Galala Mountain, a site previously unknown for its marble potential. Taking a tremendous risk, he opened the first Galala quarry, uncertain of the mountain’s capacity or commercial value. History would prove their instincts right: Galala marble soon became one of Egypt’s most prized resources, drawing visits and praise from the world’s largest importers of raw material blocks. Encouraged by the success of the Galala quarry, Alhag Saed Alghanam continued to explore new sites, founding the Zafraana, Samaha, and Sunny Elsheikh Fadl quarries. Over time, the Alghanam family secured more than 50 active quarries—Wadi Degla under Alhag Saed Alghanam leadership owned 7 quarries of them across the Galala mountain alone. This extensive quarry network allowed us to supply to top exporter in Egypt; they were the first to show the whole world the Galala marble, elevating our country’s standing in monumental projects around the globe.
history.secondGenTitle: Passing the Torch to the Second Generation
history.secondGenText: While the quarries thrived, Alhag Sameh Alghanam—son of Alhag Saed—was gaining hands-on experience. In 2000, the family opened its first factory, expanding operations from raw material extraction to fabrication and processing. Alhag Sameh forged strategic partnerships with some of China’s largest companies, who relied heavily on our quarries’ production. As demand grew, so did our footprint: in 2011, the second factory was launched, followed by new 7 quarries in the Galala mountain. For 17 years, we maintained our strong relationship with the Chinese market, sustaining a robust local presence. Eventually, the third factory came into operation, further strengthening our production capacity and enabling us to meet the escalating demand for Egyptian marble and granite.
history.thirdGenTitle: The Rise of a New Generation
history.thirdGenText: When Saed Alghanam, the third generation, entered the scene, he was no stranger to the business. From the age of 11, he spent summers and winters in the quarries and factories, learning side by side with his father and grandfather. By the time he graduated college in 2024, Saed had already been working consistently since 2023, bringing a fresh perspective and an enduring passion for global business. Determined to expand beyond the local market, he established Wadi Degla Global Exporting, dedicated to showcasing Egyptian marble and granite on an international stage. Around the same time, the family opened the Creamy White Pearl Quarry in Sinai—an even lighter and brighter version of Galala marble, exclusive to Wadi Degla. With control over three major quarries in Egypt, the Alghanam family began promoting Creamy White Pearl as a limited-edition signature product. Growing Global Influence: Under Saed’s leadership, we embarked on a new era of worldwide export and distribution. We first targeted Latin America, supplying prestigious mega-projects and luxury hotels. Our high-quality materials quickly gained a strong reputation, spurring further expansions into Europe and Africa. Today, Wadi Degla’s footprint can be found in marquee developments across the globe, from grand hotel lobbies to soaring architectural landmarks.
history.legacyText1: Throughout our history, the Alghanam family has produced numerous influential figures who have all played pivotal roles in securing and shaping Egypt’s quarrying industry. This passion has been passed down through generations—it's in our veins.
history.legacyText2: In tribute to our rich history, we proudly share photographs of Alhag Saed Alghanam from the 1980s and 1990s, both in Egyptian quarries and abroad—particularly in Turkey, where he explored international partnerships. These images symbolize our ongoing commitment to excellence, tradition, and global collaboration.
history.finalText1: Decades of expertise, three generations of visionary leaders, and an unwavering dedication to quality have earned the Alghanam family—and Wadi Degla—a place at the forefront of the marble and granite industry. We continue to push the boundaries of quarrying and fabrication, pioneering new techniques and materials that uphold our family’s time-honored standards of craftsmanship.
history.finalText2: From Galala to the World, our journey is a testament to what passion, perseverance, and ingenuity can achieve. As we look to the future, we remain true to the same principles that guided our founders: respect for nature’s gifts, dedication to excellence, and an unyielding commitment to sharing Egypt’s finest marble and granite with the world.

kerbstone.metaDescription: Premium Egyptian granite kerbstones for infrastructure, landscaping and luxury developments.
kerbstone.introText1: Wadi Degla offers premium-quality kerbstones crafted from authentic Egyptian granite, renowned for its exceptional durability, strength, and natural beauty. Our kerbstones are ideal for infrastructure, urban planning, landscaping, and luxury developments, providing both functionality and a sophisticated aesthetic.
kerbstone.introText2: Manufactured in Wadi Degla’s advanced factories, our granite kerbstones are available in a variety of surface finishes such as polished, flamed, honed and sandblasted and can be customized to meet any required size or project specification. With high resistance to wear, weathering, and heavy traffic, they are the perfect choice for city streets, public walkways, hotel driveways, and premium residential projects.
kerbstone.introText3: With over 45 years of expertise and a global export presence, Wadi Degla guarantees reliable supply capacity, competitive pricing, and professional logistics support for projects across Europe, the Caribbean, and beyond.

str.title: STR KERBSTONE
str.text: Identical in design with T-kerb with an integrated drainage system. The surface water of the road is kept away from the level crossing and can seep into the ground. Quick installation in combination with standard foundations from STR.

fullBatter.title: FULL BATTER KERBSTONE
fullBatter.text: Used where a vehicle may need to ride up onto a verge in an emergency; for safety reasons these are not used when a footpath is present. Where a crossing is required for access to a private driveway, access point or pedestrian crossing, the appropriate tapers and crossing kerbs are used.

bullnose.title: BULLNOSE KERBSTONE
bullnose.text: Precision-manufactured and durable bullnose kerbs for highway and city developments that meet strict guidelines and withstand heavy traffic.

roundTop.title: ROUND TOP GARDEN EDGE
roundTop.text: Wadi Degla's round top garden edging is the perfect finishing touch to any garden or pathway, helping to create distinct areas and guiding visitors in the direction you choose. Available in many neutral colours, this edging will suit any paving from our collection.

channel.title: CHANNEL KERBSTONE
channel.text: Stone Drainage Channels are often used to create a holistic and complete expression when using granite in outdoor facilities. The gutters are available in head, middle and end pieces and help control water flow and runoff.

transition.title: TRANSITION KERBSTONE
transition.text: A transition kerb enables vehicles to cross the public pavement to access a private driveway while indicating to the driver that they are leaving the lane. Often used to border traffic islands and pedestrian crossing aids.

kerbstone.finalText1: To create a boundary and maintain a clean edge for your driveway, kerb stones add both functionality and visual appeal to your outdoor space. Beyond providing a stylish finishing touch, kerb stones and block paving edging play a vital role in the overall design of your driveway.
kerbstone.finalText2: At WADI DEGLA, we offer a wide range of high-quality kerb stones, crafted for strength, durability, and elegance. Available in various colors, textures, sizes, and designs, our kerb stones seamlessly complement any driveway project—whether in a modern or traditional setting.
kerbstone.finalText3: We provide standard sizes, but our factory is fully equipped to produce custom dimensions to meet your specific requirements. We manufacture diverse product models and are ready to deliver bespoke designs with the necessary dimensions, finishes, and materials.

Passed down through three generations, our passion for excellence and innovation has cemented our reputation as a global leader in the industry. From Egypt's legendary quarries to landmark projects across the world, we continue to shape architectural masterpieces, honoring our heritage while embracing the future. With every slab we extract and every stone we refine, we uphold a tradition of quality, expertise, and trust—bringing visions to life, one stone at a time.

home.globalQuarriesTitle: The Heart of the Natural Stone Industry
home.globalQuarriesDesc: Quarries worldwide are the foundation of the marble and granite industry, supplying the world with high-quality natural stone used in luxury construction, hotels, and architectural masterpieces.
